chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn al-Hakam, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Dates were mentioned in his presence, so he said: 'One date with you is better than one date with us, and all the dates with us are better than all the dates with you.'
ai.seo_question: What did the Imam say about the quality of dates from different regions?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) uses the metaphor of dates to illustrate the spiritual and material superiority of the Ahl al-Bayt and their region (Medina) compared to others. While acknowledging that individual items from elsewhere may be superior, he asserts that the collective abundance and quality of the Ahl al-Bayt's domain exceed all others, reflecting the concept of *Fadl* (superiority) and divine blessing (*Barakah*) associated with them. This serves as both a literal observation of agricultural excellence and a symbolic reference to the richness of their teachings and presence.
